purpose: The MAST-adapted failure-mode field for corrections-ledger entries concerning multi-agent work (Marathon R9 lane BA; vocabulary: evaluation/mast-failure-modes.json, counted by scripts/wiki_mast_modes.py). The field is held in this sidecar register, keyed by the ledger entry's date and exact title, so the ledger change is ADDITIVE ONLY: entries in wiki/rules/corrections-ledger.md are never rewritten to carry it (the guidelines-as-data precedent, evaluation/guidelines-settings.json). An assignment row states: entry_date + entry_title (the ledger entry it classifies), mode (one closed-vocabulary id), multi_agent (true — the field applies only to multi-agent work), note (why this mode, one line). A ledger entry with no row here has NO recorded failure mode and is reported as unclassified, honestly — including entries whose multi-agent character nobody has yet judged.
